usedFor: Acadle holds your learners and Slack is where your team hears, so “New User” runs “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User” in Acadle, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Staff see each newly created learner in a channel without opening the course system.

watchOut: “New User” in Acadle is polling, and a Slack post from an automation waits for your approval.
